jobs.title: Senior Application Developer (Capital Markets) (Contract)
jobs.description:
About Maybank Securities

Maybank Securities, a leading brokerage and investment bank with a reach extending across ASEAN, the UK and the US, offers a comprehensive suite of services. These include corporate finance & advisory, navigating debt and equity capital markets, derivatives trading, brokerage and research for both retail and institutional investors, and prime brokerage.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and hands-on Application Developer to join our Solution Development team. The role will focus on the development, enhancement, and support of strategic in-house platforms supporting Front Office, Risk Management, Clearing, Operations, Regulatory Reporting, and Business Intelligence functions.

The successful candidate will play a key role in extending our internal development capabilities, working closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions across multiple asset classes and markets. You will participate throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing support.

The responsibility of this role includes:

Design, develop, integrate, and maintain enterprise applications supporting trading, risk, operations, and reporting functions.
Develop new capabilities and enhancements using .NET Framework, C#, and MSSQL technologies.
Collaborate with business users, product managers, operations teams, and technology stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
Analyse business processes and identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and improve operational efficiency.
Design and optimize database structures, SQL queries, stored procedures, and reporting solutions.
Perform impact assessments and evaluate technical risks associated with system changes.
Participate in application integration initiatives across internal and third-party platforms.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide ongoing application support and maintenance.
Maintain technical documentation, system specifications, and solution designs.
Follow software engineering best practices, including version control, code reviews, testing, release management, and change governance.
Contribute to strategic technology initiatives supporting business growth, risk management, and regulatory requirements.
Champion the organization's values, culture, and customer-first mindset while fostering a collaborative and high-performance working environment.

Qualification requirement:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
3 to 8 years of experience in application development within financial services, capital markets, investment banking, or trading environments.
Strong hands-on development experience with: C#, .NET Framework / .NET, Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL), Stored Procedures and Database Performance Tuning, GitHub and source control practices.
Good understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and software engineering principles.
Experience developing and supporting business-critical applications in a production environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Knowledge of capital markets products including Equities, FX, Futures, Options, Fixed Income, and Derivatives.
Understanding of front-to-back trade lifecycle and post-trade processing workflows.
Experience integrating with broker, exchange, market data, clearing, or settlement platforms.

Good to have:

Familiarity with FIX Protocol and electronic trading connectivity.
Experience working with large-scale reporting, business intelligence, or data management platforms.
Exposure to cloud technologies, APIs, and modern application architecture is advantageous.

This is a 12-month contract role with potential for renewal based on performance and business needs.

We regret that only short-listed candidates will be notified.

jobs.title: Internship - Full Stack Developer (Unit Process Excellence)
jobs.description:
The Unit Process Excellence team is focused on establishing frameworks and standardizing processes for all backend sites to optimize efficiency. As part of this mission, we are developing a standardized analytics tool that will enable data-driven decision-making across all backend sites. This tool will serve as a unified platform to monitor, analyze, and sustain operational excellence while ensuring scalability and consistency across the sites. The selected interns—one Data Analyst and one Full Stack Developer—will actively contribute to building this solution and maintaining existing tools. Together, their work will play a pivotal role in transforming backend operations into a cohesive and efficient system, driving innovation and continuous improvement.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

Application Development: Design, develop, and implement scalable analytics tools for backend sites using modern web technologies.
Backend Engineering: Create and maintain backend APIs and databases to securely and efficiently store and retrieve performance metrics.
Frontend Development: Implement user-friendly, responsive interfaces to improve usability for operational teams.
System Maintenance: Troubleshoot, update, and maintain existing solutions to enhance usability and performance.

Internship Learning Outcomes:

End-to-End Project Experience: Gain hands-on experience contributing to a high-impact industry-grade analytics project from development to deployment.
Data-Driven Problem Solving: Build expertise in data-driven problem-solving and process optimization within a real-world manufacturing context.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Learn to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams while aligning technical solutions with business objectives.
Technical & Project Skills Enhancement: Strengthen technical and project management skills through exposure to advanced tools, technologies, and methodologies used in backend manufacturing.

Your Profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

Education: On track to attain a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer-related course with a research-oriented mindset.
Programming Knowledge: Solid understanding of front-end and back-end programming languages and frameworks (e.g., JavaScript/React for frontend; Node.js, Django, or Flask for backend).
Database & API Proficiency: Proficient in working with databases (SQL/NoSQL) and APIs for seamless integration.
Cloud & DevOps Exposure: Experience or understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and version control systems (e.g., Git) is highly beneficial.
Preferred intake: Jan 27 - May/ June 27

jobs.title: Jr. Game Developer
jobs.description:
Samsun Atakum’daki ofisimizde bizimle birlikte öğrenecek, gelişecek ve oyun dünyasında kendine sağlam bir yer edinmek isteyen bir Jr. Game Developer arıyoruz.

Genel Nitelikler

Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Dijital Oyun Tasarımı veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun ya da bu alanda kendini geliştirmeye oldukça tutkulu,
Unity veya Unreal Engine oyun motorlarına aşina ve bu ortamda üretim yapmaya hevesli,
C# veya C++ dillerinden en az birine ve Nesne Yönelimli Programlama (OOP) prensiplerine temel düzeyde hakim,
Versiyon kontrol sistemlerinin (Git, GitHub, GitLab vb.) temel mantığını bilen ve kullanmaya istekli,
Clean code (temiz kod) kültürünü benimsemeye ve performans optimizasyonu konularında kendini geliştirmeye açık,
Öğrenme eğrisi yüksek, araştırmayı seven ve karşılaştığı hataları çözmek için motive olan,
Kişisel projeler, okul projeleri veya Game Jam'ler aracılığıyla oyun geliştirdiğini gösterebilecek bir portfolyoya sahip.

Harika Olurdu

Daha önce mobil (iOS/Android) veya PC platformunda küçük çaplı da olsa oyun/prototip yayınlamış olmak,
Oyun geliştirme süreçleri (tasarım, prototipleme, test) hakkında teorik veya pratik bilgi,
UI/UX entegrasyonu veya animasyon sistemleri gibi konularda temel deneyim.

İş Tanımı

Kıdemli takım arkadaşlarıyla koordineli çalışarak geliştirilmekte olan projelerin oyun mekaniklerini ve sistemlerini kodlamaya destek olmak,
Tasarım ve sanat ekipleriyle iletişim halinde kalarak oyun içi varlıkların (asset) ve animasyonların entegrasyonunu sağlamak,
Oyunların test süreçlerine katılmak, tespit edilen hataların (bug) giderilmesinde ve optimizasyon süreçlerinde aktif rol almak,
Ekibin genel kodlama standartlarına uyum sağlayarak mevcut projelerin geliştirilme sürecine katkıda bulunmak.

Ne Sunuyoruz?

Samsun Atakum’un merkezinde, sahil şeridinde ve sosyal alanlara yakın, keyifli bir ofis ortamı,
Kendinizi sürekli geliştirebileceğiniz, fikirlerinize değer verilen, hiyerarşiden uzak bir ekip kültürü,
Projelerimizi en yüksek performansla geliştirebilmeniz için güncel ve güçlü materyaller.

Eğer sen de oyun sektörüne güçlü bir adım atmak, bizimle birlikte büyümek istiyorsan, güncel CV ve geliştirdiğin projeleri içeren portfolyon ile başvurunu tamamlayabilirsin.

jobs.title: Full Stack Microsoft Developer
jobs.description:
Je vertaalt complexe klantvragen naar stabiele en goed werkende applicaties. Dat doe je met .NET, TypeScript en moderne Microsoft-technologieën zoals Dynamics 365, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI en Azure. Je bouwt oplossingen die technisch sterk zijn, maar vooral ook echt in de praktijk worden gebruikt.

Jouw DNA ontmoet ons DNA

Bij Alistar draait alles om vooruitgang, menselijk en technologisch. We verbinden mensen, data en technologie om samen slimmer te werken en verder te kijken. We zijn nieuwsgierige doeners die niet bang zijn om te ontdekken, te proberen en te groeien. Want leren doe je door te doen en fouten horen daar gewoon bij. Onze blik? Gericht op de toekomst. Ons hart? Dicht bij elkaar. We dromen groot, maar blijven met beide voeten op de grond. Hier krijg je de ruimte om jezelf uit te dagen, initiatief te nemen en mee te bouwen aan iets dat beweegt. Brave yourself for progress, samen maken we groei echt menselijk.
Je komt terecht in de Customer Engagement-unit binnen onze Public Business Line. Dit team bestaat uit ongeveer 18 technische consultants die zich volledig richten op Dynamics 365 en het Power Platform. Samen met functionele consultants, projectmanagers en (pre)sales collega’s werk je aan oplossingen die publieke organisaties helpen digitaliseren.

Van uitdaging naar oplossing

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt oplossingen binnen Dynamics 365 en het Power Platform
Je breidt functionaliteit uit met TypeScript en .NET-oplossingen, en bouwt nieuwe componenten met deze technologieën
Je werkt aan zowel de backend als aan gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces
Je werkt mee aan CI/CD en geautomatiseerde deployments zodat changes vlot en gecontroleerd doorstromen naar hogere omgevingen
Je stemt veel af met functionele consultants en collega-developers
Je test je werk zorgvuldig, legt het goed vast en bewaakt de kwaliteit van je code
Je denkt actief mee over hoe het beter, slimmer en efficiënter kan
Je werkt in Agile teams met Azure DevOps aan vaak langdurige projecten binnen de publieke sector

Wat jij kan, maakt het verschil

Je hebt ervaring met .NET , TypeScript en React
Je hebt feeling met Dynamics 365 en het Power Platform
Je voelt je thuis in Azure integraties: Functions, Service Bus, Logic Apps, ...
Ervaring met IaC, CI/CD pipelines en DevOps boards is een sterk pluspunt
Je werkt gestructureerd en weet goed prioriteiten te stellen
Je schrijft schone, onderhoudbare code en duidelijke documentatie
Je snapt wat er in de business speelt en denkt mee in oplossingen
Je werkt zelfstandig, maar vindt samenwerken minstens zo belangrijk

Investeren in jou, investeren in groei

Bij Alistar draait alles om vooruitgang, ook voor jou. We willen dat je groeit, je goed voelt en trots bent op wat je doet. Daarom zorgen we voor voordelen die echt iets betekenen:
💰 Een eerlijk loon, afgestemd op jouw ervaring, kennis en impact
🚗 Een bedrijfswagen, zodat je vlot en flexibel onderweg bent
🛜 Maandelijkse nettovergoedingen voor internet en mobiel, zodat je altijd goed verbonden blijft
🎁 Een sterke pensioenregeling, want jouw toekomst telt evenveel als het heden
🏡 Thuiswerkmogelijkheden en flexibiliteit, voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en leven
🏝 Ruime verlofdagen en vakantiegeld, zodat je de tijd krijgt om te ontspannen en nieuwe energie op te doen
💸 Een motiverende targetregeling, die je beloont voor je inzet en impact
🎉 We vieren samen successen, groot of klein want vooruitgang maken we samen, stap voor stap
